title: Wonderlands×Showtime Chapter1 Episode14 A Smile Lost

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So, you're the real Nene who was controlling that robot?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Nene... It's okay, no need to feel bad.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I recharged the robot. It's fully operational again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
You forgot to charge it...
I can't believe my show was ruined all because of such a stupid mistake!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Tsukasa, it's not like Nene did it on purpose.
After we left yesterday, she stayed behind to rehearse until late.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's partially my fault too. I forgot to check the battery before the show. Next time, I'll make sure—

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: “Next time”? And what about today's audience?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: There's a different show every day. Each time we perform, we're battling to win over the hearts of the audience. That's why we must succeed each and every time!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Didn't you all want to make today's show a success?! Or are you going to tell me you didn't care?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: It's because I was...too scared to perform in person. I shouldn't have relied on a robot...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So you admit it?! I should've known there was something wrong with you, staying hidden and only talking to us through a robot!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: So you're a shy girl? Not good with public performances? You think that's an excuse?! If you can't even face your audience, how can you put on a good show?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Don't you think you went too far?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You're right that it's impossible to do great shows when one of the actors can't face the audience.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But you seem to be forgetting about something even more basic.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You can't stage great shows alone, either.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Maybe I'm a hypocrite.
I've been performing solo for a long time, after all.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: But since joining this troupe, it's become clearer to me than ever before how much more interesting shows become when you work together.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Fellow performers should be valued. What are you trying to achieve picking on your colleague who is already feeling terribly guilty over what happened?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I'm disappointed to see that you don't seem to have a true passion for theater after all.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
No! You're wrong!
I put my heart and soul into making our show the best it could be!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
I've always given my all to performances!
Always trying my best to one day achieve stardom!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Hmph. That's all you care about? So I'm right then.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: To you, theater is just a means of achieving some selfish, personal goal.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Wait, how can you say that...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I won't be coming here anymore.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: You don't have what it takes to become a star.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Why? Why do you think I don't have what it takes?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I just wanted to say I had lots of fun today!
I really enjoyed performing in front of an audience!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
That's why... I want to try again!
Next time everything will go just fine!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Didn't you like being in the show?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What now?
No one is smiling anymore...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
I'm sorry, Nene. For making you join that troupe.
Also, I should've checked the robot's battery.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
.....
No, I... I messed this up...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
We won't be needing it anymore.
I left it back at the stage.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I won't force you to perform in a show ever again.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: For crying out loud... Why did it have to end this way?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: I just...wanted to stage a great show...

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Huh? What was that flash? My...phone?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It was that song, “Untitled.”
Why did it do that?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: If there's anything else you need help with, you're welcome to visit us anytime.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
It's so quiet... Where is everyone?
Normally Miku and KAITO would come out right away...
